findings.text: `aioson system:package .` drops every folder named `reports` by name (DEV_ONLY_DIRS in @jaimevalasek/aioson src/commands/store-system.js, matched at any depth). The 8 files of src/features/reports/ (PortfolioReportPage, ReportCenterPage, ReportDelivery, ReportOptions, ReportPreview, ReportSheet, ReportSheetCharts, useReportPreview) are missing from the store package, so `vite build` in the postinstall of a store install/update fails with UNLOADABLE_DEPENDENCY (src/features/settings/BrandSection.tsx imports @/features/reports/ReportSheet). Not fixable from this unit: system.json build_output_dirs only works in --build mode and src/** belongs to the frontend lane. Fix: rename src/features/reports to a name the packager keeps (e.g. report-center) and update its imports. scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs now fails clearly on this (assertPackageContents lists the dropped files).

`node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs` run as shipped FAILS today because of the packager defect above (exit 1, step 1/8-2/8, lists the 8 dropped files). The unit Done-when only requires `node --check` on it, which passes. The rest of the flow was validated on a scratch copy kept in execution-temp that restores the 8 files into the package in memory: all 8 steps PASS (exit 0).
Updating a real 0.1.0 installation with data in the Play (Settings -> Instalar App -> Linkar pasta, or local package) and the green badge were not run here (needs the Play desktop app).

My inspection run of `aioson system:package .` left .aioson/system-packages/fitpulse/fitpulse-0.2.0.json (about 1.2 MB). Deleting it was denied in this session, so it was left in place; it is safe to delete. The store smoke treats an existing folder as the owner own and will not remove it.

messages.text: Release blocker for AC-ra-54: the store package omits src/features/reports/** because the aioson packager skips any folder named `reports`. Ask the frontend lane to rename the folder (e.g. src/features/report-center) and fix the imports (BrandSection.tsx, ReportPreview.tsx, ReportSheet.tsx and whatever else), then run `node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs` (about 5 min, needs network/pnpm cache, aioson CLI on PATH) and expect PASS.

Remaining checks of this phase for integration: pnpm build, pnpm test, pnpm test:e2e, node scripts/smoke-boot.mjs, node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs (after the rename), aioson harness:check . --slug=relatorios-e-acompanhamento, and the real 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0 update in the Play. AC-ra-55 and AC-ra-56 belong to the phase-7-backend-backup unit.

scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs rebuilds release 0.1.0 from the current package (no 0.1.0 archive is kept and the project is not under git): it removes the 4 migrations of 0.2.0 and the 2 questionnaire runtime files and stamps version 0.1.0 / schema_version 1 / requires_migration false. If a future release adds migrations, they are applied by the update step automatically; add the name to V2_MIGRATIONS only for a release-specific check.
